request: Quiero tres propuestas visuales con la paleta actual para preparar la consulta y el portal, antes de cerrar lo funcional.
surfaceScope: whole surface inside an established identity
confirmedConstraints: Preserve the existing NutriPlan palette and type character.
Clinical priority precedes logistics and decoration.
Use the portrait discreetly and keep imagery subordinate.
Context opens above the current view without reflow.
Keep clinician and patient perspectives distinct.
verifiedProductFacts: The compared task uses one populated clinician record and one populated patient portal.
The prototype must preserve the same synthetic patient, signals, appointment, meals and panel content.
No admin adaptation or production implementation is authorized before a real selection.

agentProposals.thesis: One dominant clinical field makes the immediate risk legible before every supporting signal.
agentProposals.visibleDifference: Diagnosis, allergy and medication form one high-contrast reading plane; visit logistics sit in a narrow secondary rail.
agentProposals.opportunity: Turn pre-consultation review into a calm briefing rather than a card dashboard.
agentProposals.risk: The dominant field can become oversized when the clinical label is long.

agentProposals.thesis: The screen reads like a clinical safety docket whose first scan is risk, medication and next action.
agentProposals.visibleDifference: A compact vertical index anchors an ordered evidence sheet with safety facts pinned at the top.
agentProposals.opportunity: Make professional rigor expressive through alignment and restraint instead of ornament.
agentProposals.risk: The docket can feel bureaucratic if the patient identity becomes too quiet.

agentProposals.thesis: A longitudinal rail connects the last contact, current signals and next consultation as one clinical story.
agentProposals.visibleDifference: Time, not cards, organizes the surface; the active decision expands beside the rail.
agentProposals.opportunity: Show why the next decision follows from recent evidence without adding prose.
agentProposals.risk: Chronology may outrank urgent safety facts unless the active state is forceful.

agentProposals.thesis: The interface reveals one decision at a time from priority to evidence to action.
agentProposals.visibleDifference: A stepped composition advances vertically; secondary evidence expands only when its step is active.
agentProposals.opportunity: Reduce simultaneous load while making the workflow itself memorable.
agentProposals.risk: Progressive disclosure can slow an expert who needs broad scanning.

agentProposals.thesis: The surface prepares the next conversation by pairing what the professional must know with what the patient must do.
agentProposals.visibleDifference: Two unequal columns share one central handoff line; clinician evidence and patient action never share navigation chrome.
agentProposals.opportunity: Give the dashboard and portal a related grammar without confusing their perspectives.
agentProposals.risk: The paired metaphor can imply simultaneous use when the real products are separate.

agentProposals.thesis: A precise signal table makes comparison and exception spotting the visual signature.
agentProposals.visibleDifference: Aligned rows, direct values and one highlighted exception replace metric cards and display headlines.
agentProposals.opportunity: Bring editorial clarity to dense clinical facts with minimal decoration.
agentProposals.risk: The patient portal needs a warmer translation to avoid feeling like a record system.

agentProposals.thesis: A continuous care ribbon keeps the next action visible while context opens around it.
agentProposals.visibleDifference: The current task remains fixed in a horizontal band while supporting panels layer above and below.
agentProposals.opportunity: Make continuity across clinician and patient states visible through one persistent interaction pattern.
agentProposals.risk: A persistent band can consume scarce height on compact screens.

claimBoundary: These candidates were recorded before invoking concept-seed. They are provisional agent proposals, not user decisions.
